newsitem.title: UK: UK new car registrations up 2.5 pct in May - SMMT.
newsitem.headline: UK new car registrations up 2.5 pct in May - SMMT.

text.p: British new car registrations rose 2.5 percent in the year to May, with a total of 169,886, the Society of Motor Manufacturers and Traders said on Thursday.
Over the year to date, registrations total 902,167, 4.9 percent up on the same period last year.

"A small reduction in fleet registrations was offset by a modest improvement in the private retail sector," said Roger King, SMMT director of public affairs. "Overall, registrations are holding up well. Nevertheless, the modest growth in May shows the market remains a tough one."
Imports made up 63.5 percent of May's registrations compared with 61.5 percent in May last year.
